notes: *that hath lain by man* is divided with *lain* on מִשְׁכָּב, whose lexeme it writes, the relative and auxiliary on the articleless attributive participle (rule 41), and *by man* on the rectum (rule 19); the competing reading keeps *hath lain* whole on the participle and marks מִשְׁכָּב unrepresented.
*utterly* is part of חרם's own rendering, no infinitive absolute standing in the clause for rule 56 to place.
